title: Date'N'Time
description: Simple mod that adds date tracking to Minecraft, with a few commands and permissions so only admins can manipulate the date.
body:
This mod adds Date tracking to Minecraft, allowing for all sorts of RP potential. The tracking is hopefully robust, if you find any issues, please report them (for now in the discord).

### **Features:**
- Automatic date tracking
- Chat message announcing a new day
- Commands for admins to set the date and pause/unpause the automatic date tracking
- Persistent through restarts

### **Commands:**
All commands are under /datentime
/datentime check: prints out the current date, only shown to the user who sent the command
/datentime set: sets the date, only usable either in Singleplayer or in Multiplayer if the user has OP
/datentime pause: pauses automatic date tracking, requires OP on servers
/datentime start: unpauses automatic date tracking, once again requires OP on servers

Automatic date tracking is enabled by default, and the default date is 1.1.1111
Format is DD.MM.YYYY

If you have any suggestions or issues, feel free to put them for now into the discord.

**You are free to use this mod in any modpack.**
